## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Clean the filter only when very dirty or after approximately 12,000 miles. [t1090]
- Use a two-stage cleaning kit for thorough maintenance. [t1090]
- Consider enclosing the cone with a paint can mod or adding a hydrophobic cover for water protection. [t1090]
- [Partial] Verify that the K&N connection ID matches the Volant air duct OD for a hybrid setup. [t1090]
